symbols.name: InMemoryCacheStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Owns authoritative in-process payloads, metadata indexes, publication fences, reader pins, and finite quota.
symbols.remarks: Restart empties the store. Shared-store source coordination and durable reconciliation require a capable persistent provider.

syntax.content: public sealed class InMemoryCacheStoreProvider : ICacheStoreProvider

symbols.name: InMemoryCacheStoreProvider(string, CacheProviderOptions, TimeProvider, CacheRuntimeResources, CacheDiagnosticsOptions)
symbols.summary: Creates finite on-demand resources; InitializeAsync establishes declared catalog compatibility without external I/O.

syntax.content: public InMemoryCacheStoreProvider(string name = "memory", CacheProviderOptions options = null, TimeProvider timeProvider = null, CacheRuntimeResources resources = null, CacheDiagnosticsOptions diagnostics = null)
